messages:
darren: Quick check — are we still cutting the runtime release today? I thought cutoff was 17:00 UTC. need a smoke sweep before I branch off for cut.
alisa: yep 17:00 UTC still. can someone run a full smoke/golden tests sweep now please? I can be on standby for fixes.
ben: doing a quick pre-merge run now: `ci job: build-and-smoke` queued. will post status.
ci-bot: build-and-smoke started on runner-7 (pipeline #6421).
deploy-bot: heads-up: rule: if smoke fails we hold the cut and gate to next slot. :warning:
carmen: if smoke hits flaky e2e again, propose we temporarily skip `tests/load_balancer/test_reconnect` and log ticket.
ben: ack. if it fails i'll capture the log and create a flaky ticket. tagging flaky tests helps cut.
ci-bot: build-and-smoke finished — 1 failing, 42 passing. failing job: integration-e2e (tests/load_balancer/test_reconnect) — flaky pattern detected.
darren: okay please don't merge. ben, can you create the flaky ticket and add steps to reproduce? include these logs:

```
FAILED tests/load_balancer/test_reconnect.py::test_reconnect_on_drop
AssertionError: connection not restored within 5s
Traceback (most recent call last):
  ...
```

ben: on it. creating ticket INFRA-876 and adding the log + job link.
ben: also opening a small patch to skip that test in the smoke pipeline only: `ci/skip_flaky_loadbalancer.yml` — wfm for this cut.
alisa: good call. once skip patch merges, can we re-run smoke and then proceed with branch cut? need changelog bump and version tag too.
darren: yes. changelog: bump runtime to 2.5.0-rc1? or 2.5.0 depending on risk. prefer rc1 for safety.
carmen: i'll do the changelog entry and PR to update `package.json`/version file. will ping for review.
ben: smoke re-run queued after skip-apply. `./scripts/run_smoke.sh --subset=golden` if anyone wants to run locally.
ci-bot: re-run build-and-smoke (with skip rule) passed — all checks green.
deploy-bot: green sweep achieved. approved to cut branch `release/2.5.0-rc1` on darren's go.
darren: cutting branch in 5m. alisa — can you tag release notes draft and confirm docs link?
alisa: will update notes, adding change summary and known flaky skip with ticket link. posting draft in #release-notes after branch cut. :thumbsup:
ben: leaving a post-merge todo: revert the smoke skip once flaky test fixed, add a proper quarantine label.
carmen: assigning INFRA-876 to myself to investigate root cause.
darren: thanks all — let's keep the roll window tight. ping here if anything blocks.
alisa: noted. thanks everyone. :rocket:
